docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,000.00 FILED BY AMERICAN AIRPORTER SHUTTLE AS TO DEFENDANT PACIFIC BELL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-12-1999 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 506
